verdict.rationale: Smithery once documented a Vercel AI SDK integration page that could aggregate tools from multiple servers. Its own shutdown notice says the Smithery API, Connect, Toolbox, CLI and SDKs stopped working on October 31, 2026, and the docs tree was removed, so no working documented framework adapter remains. There was never evidence of adapters for LangChain, CrewAI, or the OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the platform's tools into major agent frameworks and SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs) with documented adapters
